convert_xywh_to_xyxy: convert bounding box coordinates from xywh format (x, y, width, height) to xyxy format (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max)
convert_xyxy_to_xywh: convert bounding box coordinates from xyxy format (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max) to xywh format (x, y, width, height)
generate_mask_from_polygon: generate a binary mask from a polygon given vertices and image resolution width and height
convert_mask_to_rle: convert a binary mask to a COCO run-length encoding list of integers or compressed string
convert_mask_to_polygons: convert a binary mask to a list of polygons with at least three points
